caption: Trial dialog right after signup: 'The whole product is unlocked for 31 days' and 'No credit card needed', while the pricing page says a 30 day trial; the organization name is hidden.
Timer list with our three entries of 1m 30s, 2m 18s and 15m: the day header shows 18m while the Logged bar shows 19m; the organization name is hidden.

Summary report after setting a $60 hourly rate on the project: the 15 minute entry gives 15m billable (79.79%) and 15.00 USD, and every export format (PDF, CSV, XLSX) carries a paid feature star; the organization name is hidden.

Upgrade dialog on yearly billing: Starter $9 instead of $12 ('Get 3 months free') and Premium $16 instead of $24 ('Get 4 months free') per license a month; the trial ends November 28 and you can keep going free; the organization name is hidden.
Choosing Premium shows a warning that the current trial will finish immediately, so we stopped here and did not pay; the organization name is hidden.
Invite dialog during the trial: 'Free plan includes up to 5 members after the trial', while the pricing FAQ says 3 users; the account name is hidden.
Billing settings on the 'Trial - Focus Premium' plan: the row menu offers Change plan and Cancel trial.
Reimport review of our own Time logs export: the '-' placeholders are read as client, project and task names, and the time entries are skipped in match only mode; our email address is hidden.
